candidates.summary: isSeed() hides a realm the changed package actually reaches, so the affected realm never appears in the comment
candidates.failure_scenario: A PR touching gnoweb (gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/) and a package a seed realm imports — gno.land/p/nt/ufmt/v0, gno.land/p/gnoland/blog/v0 and gno.land/p/moul/dynreplacer/v0 are all imported by the seed realms r/gnoland/home and r/gnoland/blog. BuildPlan puts the realm in Plan.Realms because the changed package reaches it, gnodev renders it and Index lists it, but Comment's indirect loop drops it as a seed. With no changed realm the comment then carries no realm link at all: heading, homepage link, footer. The reviewer is told the PR affects realm sources and is shown nothing to look at.

candidates.summary: every changed realm is linked, but BuildPlan caps Plan.Realms and not Plan.ChangedRealms, so the ones past the cap link to pages that were never rendered
candidates.failure_scenario: A sweep over examples (a gofmt run, a gnomod.toml bump, a stdlib rename) changes more than -max-realms realms, default 25 (main.go:29). plan.go:256 truncates Realms and counts the rest in Dropped; ChangedRealms keeps all of them. Comment's loop at :62 emits a link per ChangedRealm, so realm 26 onward get https://<pages>/r/.../ URLs the crawler never wrote: the reviewer clicks a 404. The footer at :86 tells them the opposite — "%d more affected realm(s) were **not** rendered (cap reached) — the changed realms are always kept".
candidates.verify_by: cd misc/gnopreview && go test -run TestCommentLinksUnrenderedChangedRealms (artifact below): BuildPlan with three changed realms and maxRealms=2, then check each ChangedRealm absent from Realms against the comment text

candidates.summary: Comment links what the plan intended while Index links what the crawl produced, and only Index takes the Crawler that knows
candidates.failure_scenario: crawl.go:134 skips a page on any non-200 and keeps going, so a realm that 500s at render (a panicking init) or that gnodev never loaded (plan.go reads draft from gnomod.toml at plan.go:142 and then filters on Ignore alone, never on Draft) leaves c.pages without an entry. Index(p, c) at comment.go:170 filters on exactly that and omits the realm; Comment has no Crawler parameter and links it anyway, plus the /_t/source/ and /_t/help/ tabs at :148. The reviewer gets a list whose links 404 and an index that silently disagrees with it. The deeper fix is one source of truth: pass the Crawler to Comment and gate every link on FileOf, which also covers the cap case above.
